userStories.title: Add pre-flight caption availability check using --list-subs
acceptanceCriteria: Add _check_subtitle_availability(video_id) method to CaptionFetcher that runs 'yt-dlp --list-subs <video_id>' and parses available subtitle tracks
Method returns a dict with keys: 'has_manual', 'has_auto', 'available_formats', 'available_languages'
Call _check_subtitle_availability() before attempting any caption downloads in fetch_captions()
If no subtitles exist (has_manual=False and has_auto=False), return early with CaptionUnavailableError without cycling through formats
Add unit test that mocks yt-dlp output and verifies fast-fail behavior saves ~40 seconds vs current format cycling
Log the availability check result at DEBUG level for observability
userStories.notes: ALREADY IMPLEMENTED (US-59-002, US-60-002, US-60-005): list_available_languages() runs --list-subs (line 2560-2630), list_available_subtitles() returns structured SubtitleAvailabilityResult (lines 2718-2759) with available_manual_languages, available_auto_languages, has_any_subtitles. fetch_captions() calls this FIRST (line 4326) and returns early with CaptionUnavailableError when no subs (lines 4331-4343). Tests in tests/test_caption_preflight.py verify fast-fail saves ~40s. DEBUG logging at line 2715.

userStories.title: Add auto-generated caption fallback with --write-auto-sub
acceptanceCriteria: After manual caption formats fail, attempt auto-generated captions using --write-auto-sub flag
Parse auto-generated caption result and mark is_auto_generated=True in CaptionResult
Integrate with existing determine_caption_quality() function to set quality='medium' for auto-generated
Add config option caption_first.allow_auto_generated (default: true) to enable/disable this fallback
Add unit test that verifies auto-generated captions are fetched when manual unavailable
Log when falling back to auto-generated captions at INFO level
userStories.notes: ALREADY IMPLEMENTED (US-59-007): All acceptance criteria met. (1) _fetch_subtitle() catches CaptionUnavailableError/CaptionFormatUnavailableError and retries with auto_generated=True (lines 4564-4580); (2) _fetch_subtitle_with_format() uses '--write-auto-subs' flag (line 4700) and sets is_auto_generated=auto_generated in CaptionResult (line 4807); (3) determine_caption_quality() in src/caption/quality.py sets quality='medium' for is_auto_generated=True (lines 68-73); (4) Config field 'allow_auto_generated: bool = True' in CaptionFirstConfig (line 504) and config.yaml (line 1060), checked via _is_auto_fallback_allowed() (lines 4583-4590); (5) tests/test_caption_auto_fallback.py has 15 tests covering all cases (all pass); (6) logger.info() at lines 4568-4570 logs 'Manual captions unavailable, falling back to auto-generated'.

userStories.title: Add negative caching for videos without captions
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'no_captions_available' result type to CaptionCache with configurable TTL (default: 3600 seconds)
When caption fetch fails due to unavailability, store negative result in cache
On cache lookup, return early with CaptionUnavailableError if negative cache hit
Add config option caption_first.negative_cache_ttl_seconds (default: 3600)
Add unit test that verifies second request for same captionless video returns immediately from cache
Log cache hit/miss for negative results at DEBUG level
userStories.notes: IMPLEMENTED (building on US-59-003/US-60-004): (1) 'unavailable=True' field on CachedCaption marks no-caption entries with TTL via negative_cache_ttl_seconds (default 3600s = 1 hour); (2) store_unavailable() called in fetch_captions when CaptionUnavailableError; (3) is_caption_unavailable() checked at start of fetch_captions(), returns early with CaptionUnavailableError mentioning 'Negative cache'; (4) Added caption_first.negative_cache_ttl_seconds config option to config.yaml and CaptionFirstConfig; (5) test_second_fetch_hits_negative_cache_zero_ytdlp_calls verifies immediate cache return; (6) Changed log level to DEBUG for negative cache hits (was INFO). All 20 tests in test_negative_cache.py pass.

userStories.title: Propagate structured no-caption status to caption_stage
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'status' field to CaptionResult with values: 'success', 'no_captions', 'error', 'cached_unavailable'
In CaptionStage.run(), handle 'no_captions' status without treating it as an error
Videos with no_captions status should be marked for transcription fallback in state.videos_needing_transcription
Add log message at INFO level listing count of videos with no captions available
Add unit test that verifies pipeline continues when some videos have no captions
Update checkpoint data to track no_captions_count metric
userStories.notes: IMPLEMENTED: (1) Added CaptionStatus enum to src/caption/enums.py with values: SUCCESS, NO_CAPTIONS, ERROR, CACHED_UNAVAILABLE; (2) Added status field to CaptionResult in caption_fetcher.py and caption/models.py with default=CaptionStatus.SUCCESS; (3) Updated fetch_captions_batch error handlers to set status field in error dicts; (4) caption_stage.py now uses status field for counting success/no_captions/error; (5) Added INFO log with US-63-006 tag listing count of videos with no captions; (6) Videos with no_captions/cached_unavailable/error status added to needs_transcription; (7) Added 5 new tests in TestCaptionStatusField class verifying status field handling; (8) no_captions_count already tracked in checkpoint_data. All 18 tests in test_caption_stage.py pass.

Populate breakdown during TieredMatcher scoring with adjustments from: duration penalty, topic penalty, broll boost, caption quality, timing penalty
Include breakdown in Match serialization for checkpoint storage
Add unit test that verifies breakdown captures all applied adjustments
Log confidence breakdown at DEBUG level when verbose matching enabled
userStories.notes: IMPLEMENTED: (1) Added 'confidence_breakdown: List[Dict[str, Any]]' field to Match dataclass in src/utils.py with default_factory=list; (2) Populated breakdown in all 3 TieredMatcher Match creation paths (obvious match @752, high embedding @851, LLM reranking @1008) using _record_breakdown helper; (3) Match.to_dict() includes breakdown when non-empty, Match.from_dict() restores it (backward-compatible); (4) Added 11 unit tests in TestMatchConfidenceBreakdownField (8 tests) and TestTieredMatcherPopulatesBreakdown (3 tests); (5) Changed DEBUG log tag to 'US-63-007 confidence breakdown' in all 3 paths. userStories.title: Add LLM reranker confidence calibration based on candidate spread
acceptanceCriteria: In LLMReranker.rerank(), calculate score spread between top-2 candidates
If spread < 0.05 (very close), apply confidence reduction factor (e.g., 0.9x)
If spread > 0.20 (clear winner), apply confidence boost factor (e.g., 1.1x, capped at 1.0)
Add config options: llm_reranker.close_spread_threshold, llm_reranker.clear_winner_threshold
Add unit test with mocked LLM that verifies confidence adjustments based on spread
Log spread and adjustment at DEBUG level
userStories.notes: Tier: P2 (quality refinement). Target file: src/matching/llm_reranker.py. LLM reranking confidence should reflect certainty based on how close the top candidates are. Very close candidates indicate ambiguity; large spread indicates clear winner.

userStories.title: Add diversity penalty for consecutive same-source matches
acceptanceCriteria: In TieredMatcher.match_segment(), check if previous N matches used same video source
Apply configurable penalty (default: 0.1) per consecutive same-source match
Add config option: matching.consecutive_source_penalty (default: 0.1)
Add config option: matching.max_consecutive_same_source (default: 3) - hard cap
Add unit test that verifies penalty is applied and stacks for multiple consecutive
Record penalty in confidence_breakdown (depends on US-63-007)
userStories.notes: Tier: P2 (quality diversity). Target file: src/matching/tiered_matcher.py. Visual variety in final edit is important. Currently no penalty for reusing same source in adjacent segments. ReuseTracker exists but operates globally, not on consecutive sequences.

userStories.title: Add match quality trend logging across voiceover chunks
acceptanceCriteria: After matching each 10% chunk of voiceover segments, log rolling average confidence
Identify and log segments where confidence dropped significantly (>0.2 below running average)
Add summary at end of MATCH stage showing confidence trend: improving, stable, or degrading
Add unit test that verifies trend calculation with mock match results
Store trend data in checkpoint for post-run analysis
userStories.notes: Tier: P3 (analytics). Target files: src/stages/match.py, src/matching/metrics.py. Helps identify problematic voiceover sections (e.g., technical jargon, abstract concepts) that consistently match poorly. Enables targeted query refinement in ITERATIVE_MATCH.

userStories.title: Add gap pattern analysis logging for iterative match optimization
acceptanceCriteria: In IterativeMatchStage, analyze gap segments after each pass for common patterns
Identify and log: gaps with similar voiceover topics, gaps at similar timeline positions, gaps with specific keyword patterns
Generate query hints based on gap patterns (e.g., 'Consider searching for: [extracted common terms]')
Add unit test that verifies pattern detection with mock gap data
Store gap analysis in checkpoint for cross-run learning
userStories.notes: Tier: P3 (intelligence). Target file: src/stages/iterative_match.py. Gap pattern analysis helps identify systematic matching failures. Query learning database exists but doesn't analyze gap clustering. This enables smarter query generation in subsequent passes.
